name: Home Icon
description: Icon for selecting the home page

variations.name: default
variations.description: Click the icon to toggle the selected state. The icon will animate to indicate selection.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Controls the selected state of the icon.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the outline/fill crossfade in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: draw
variations.description: Stroke animation draws the house from foundation to roof during loading

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Triggers the draw animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each stroke draw in seconds; the stagger scales with it

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the stroke draw. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.
